title: Model Options
brief: The model editor's options: tests, history, element templates, extended forms.
description: What the model editor offers, each switched on or off: the Test tab (a model's scenarios, run in the engine), the History tab (each save kept as a version), element templates (configured tasks), and extended forms (a form field's choices from a source).
